scope: Exact source-only batch protocol and policy review for isolated synthetic fixtures; no provider, browser, or candidate model execution by reviewer
conclusion: No additional defect found in the intended synchronous fixture/runner composition, conditional on listed integration obligations.
verified_properties: JSON duplicate/nonfinite/unknown-field and response-size refusals remain; all1..8 actions validate before any action becomes executable.
Done is allowed only at the final batch position and its success claim never becomes evaluator success.
Total eight dispatches remain the ceiling. Whole new batch must fit remaining dispatch capacity before its prefix is returned.
Every queued action revalidates current enabled visible fixture target, ID/tag/type/label identity and unchanged dropdown text-to-value translation.
Ordinary value and checked-state changes are allowed; model action correctness still belongs to the fixture oracle.
Prior executor rejection clears all queued suffix actions before any fresh inference. Stale queued target clears the suffix and yields an invalid response without model inference.
Queued dispatches return zero prompt/completion tokens. Actual inference usage passes through unchanged; there is no repeated raw batch charge.
History joins each actual dispatch response and preserves each original model batch exactly once, with execution feedback qualified as no reported rejection rather than task success.
Native exception/cancellation leaves the adapter consumed. finish seals and clears unused suffix, without claiming it cancels native work.
Only task goal, allowed fixture IDs, visible observations and screenshot are used to build model input. Fixture HTML, reference plan and oracle are not serialized.
required_v4_integration: Call policy.finish() in every episode finally, before context closure, and preserve returned actual_model_calls/policy_dispatches/native_disposition_unknown counts for completed and partial episodes.
Keep run_task.policy_calls labelled as policy dispatches. Use root generation counter and policy.finish actual_model_calls for model-call metrics.
Preserve every raw inference batch and queued-event kind in the saved row; do not present unexecuted discarded actions as executed.
Freeze the new interface and run baseline and all candidates with the same batch behavior, action/time/token limits and oracle.
Keep v3 failed result immutable. Do not use replay or retrospective reinterpretation to mark it passed.
Retain existing provider lifecycle and budget admission guards; this source review grants no new spending or provider action authority.
test_evidence: Author reported42 pure evaluator tests passing. Reviewer inspected their source, including four-action one-inference execution, stale/rejected queue discard, atomic malformed suffix refusal, token accounting, cap and task-end discard; reviewer did not rerun them.
limits: This remains an isolated fixed-ID HTML interface, not full Browser Use or arbitrary real-site element identity.
One observation precedes execution; existing executor rechecks visibility/enabled state. No arbitrary concurrent DOM mutation or complete async safety claim.
GPU/native cancellation and physical deallocation require the separate supervisor/provider evidence.
No runtime correctness, model improvement, benchmark generalization, or Astra comparison follows from this review.
